description: Abstract class for processing device-related RPCs in the Thingsboard edge service, including device creation, update, credentials management, and deletion.

classes.name: BaseDeviceProcessor
classes.description: Abstract class providing device processing functionalities for the edge RPC layer in Thingsboard.

methods.name: saveOrUpdateDevice
methods.description: Handles creation or update of a device based on the provided update message, including validation and name duplication checks.

methods.name: updateDeviceNameIfDuplicateExists
methods.description: Checks for duplicate device names and updates the device name to a unique one if necessary.

methods.name: updateDeviceCredentials
methods.description: Updates the credentials of a device based on the provided credentials update message.

methods.name: setCustomerId
methods.description: Abstract method to set the customer ID for a device, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: deleteDevice
methods.description: Deletes a device by its ID, optionally with an associated edge context.
